answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging jade-like hardness assumptions to ensure verifiable uniqueness. By harnessing verifiable delay functions and island-hopping strategies for leader sortition, agents are bound to distinct identities. Utilizing a quill-like commitment scheme, honest agents can prove reputation without revealing underlying data, while malicious clones are thwarted by information-theoretic unforgeability, guaranteeing Byzantine fault tolerance and cryptographic finality.
